audit_method: Independent Python parsing of saved files; no solver/build/test launch; no imports from verification helpers

single/direct.direct_reference_diagnostic_limit: No solver_report/linear_report; Newton counts imply corrections but their true linear residuals and reason codes were not recorded

multiple/direct-two.direct_reference_diagnostic_limit: No solver_report/linear_report; Newton counts imply corrections but their true linear residuals and reason codes were not recorded

metrics_crosscheck: All listed field errors, circuit defects, correction counts, outer iteration totals and true-residual ratios match independent reconstruction
performance_limit: Single shared-host samples at 350 and 1020 DoF; timings are sums of solver_report phase fields, not controlled repeated benchmarks or whole-job wall times; no stable speedup/scaling claim
